levels.surface: محمد بن يحيى بن سعيد القطان

notes: The asked man answers in his own place (rule 6): فقال عن أبيه, so the father, whose words the saying is, is the last link as a relation.
قال مسلم يقول ... is the compiler's own remark, not a route.
The first speaker, ابن أبي عتاب, is the same man as the أنا who asked; read once.
